tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities with garbage-truck collection data, with their ids and bounding boxes.

tools.name: find_nearby_points
tools.description: Find garbage-truck stops near a coordinate in Taipei, New Taipei, Taichung or Kaohsiung, nearest first, with arrival times. Searches every city whose area overlaps the radius unless `city` is given.

tools.name: search_points
tools.description: Search one city's stops by district, village, location or route text (Traditional Chinese). All space-separated terms must match, e.g. "大安區 安和路".

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Get one collection point by id (from find_nearby_points or search_points) plus every stop on the same route in arrival order.
